projects.name: Digital Forensics Investigation Lab
projects.description: Designed and staged a simulated security breach within an isolated virtual-machine lab environment, generating realistic forensic artifacts including dropped and deleted files, manipulated timestamps, persistence mechanisms, and network exfiltration traffic. Conducted end-to-end digital forensic analysis using Autopsy and Volatility, recovering deleted artifacts, reconstructing file-system timelines, and identifying memory-resident indicators of compromise and suspicious process activity. Performed network forensics with Wireshark to trace and reconstruct exfiltrated data, correlating disk, memory, and network evidence into a single verified incident timeline. Documented findings in a formal incident reconstruction report with chain-of-custody records and SHA-256 evidence hashing, supporting evidentiary integrity and reporting practices consistent with incident response standards.

projects.name: Cryptographic Key Management System (CKMS)
projects.description: Engineered a secure web-based key management system using Python, Flask, SQLite, and cryptographic libraries, applying AES-GCM, RSA-OAEP, and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 for encrypted key storage and protection. Documented key lifecycle management processes — including generation, rotation, revocation, and audit logging — with role-based access control and an interactive reporting dashboard.

projects.name: Integrated Architecture for Security in Cloud Computing Based on Blockchain
projects.description: Designed a secure cloud storage architecture combining Elliptic Curve Integrated Encryption with Ethereum blockchain for data confidentiality and integrity via encryption and decentralized hash verification. Built and documented smart contracts for hash management and integrity checks, lowering false verification errors by 18% and raising data integrity accuracy to 94%.

projects.name: IoT Botnet Detection using Deep Learning and Machine Learning Techniques for Network Traffic Analysis (Publication)
projects.description: Co-authored research applying Decision Tree, Random Forest, and 1D-CNN deep learning models to the Bot-IoT dataset to classify network traffic and detect botnet-driven DDoS, DoS, data theft, and reconnaissance attacks with over 99% accuracy. Published in International Journal of Research Publication and Reviews (IJRPR).
